title: Amelia | Relaxed Hoodie Cardigan for Every Season
bodyHtml:
This is the hooded cardigan you'll reach for constantly—whether you're layering through cooler days or wearing it solo when the weather softens. It's warm enough to take the place of a heavier jacket, yet light enough never to feel restrictive. Slip it on over a tee, blouse or light knit, or wear it loose as your go-to comfort piece. Once you discover how effortlessly versatile it is, you won't look back.

Why you'll love it

  • The perfect layering piece that adds warmth without bulk or weight
  • Soft, embracing fabric that skims your frame—wear it buttoned or open, it always looks right
  • All-day comfort whether you're at home, the office, travelling or out and about
  • Works with everything—jeans, trousers, dresses, skirts—and pulls together any outfit in seconds
  • Warm enough for cooler evenings, light enough for mild days
  • The hoodie detail adds that extra dash of ease and personality
  • Limited stock from our 30-Year Anniversary Collection—grab yours before it's gone

Over 50,000 women have already chosen us, with an average rating of 4.8 out of 5. Your happiness and your trust mean everything to us.
